caption_L1: Cyprus : Youth unemployment rate from 1999 to 2020 is a line chart. The y-axis measures Youth unemployment rate. A linear scale with a minimum of 2000 and a maximum of 2015 can be seen on the x-axis, marked Year.
caption_L2L3: The unemployment rate was stable from 1999 to about 2008, then it rises sharply from about 0.1 to nearly 0.4 in 2012/3. After than it drop significantly again and below 0.2 till the end of 2020.
